narr: Non-severe thunderstorms tracked across Allegheny County during the evening of September 7th. Localized 3-hour rainfall totals of 1.5 to 2.5 inches north of Pittsburgh created some localized flash flooding issues.
ev: Flooding was reported on Pine Creek Road near Old Perry Highway. Another report indicates that several vehicles were stranded in the area.
Pine Creek was out of its banks near Huntington Court.
lsr: Water over Pine Creek road near Old Perry Highway (Route 19).
Road closed near 9840 Old Perry Highway due to flooding. Several vehicles stranded.
